{{Quote|Petty Officer Bren. Mess deck accommodation to everyone's satisfaction?''"<br />"''Small problem with the water pressure in A-seven-two 'freshers, sir, but that's been resolved.''"<br />"''Splendid. Carry on.|Gilad Pellaeon and Bren|<ref name="NoPrisoners" />}}
'''Bren''' was a [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone trooper]] who served as a [[Petty Officer/Legends|petty officer]] on the [[Republic Navy/Legends|Republic Navy's]] [[Acclamator-class transgalactic military assault ship/Legends|Republic assault ship]] ''[[Leveler]]'' under [[Commanding officer/Legends|command]] of [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Gilad Pellaeon/Legends|Gilad Pellaeon]],<ref name="NoPrisoners" /> in [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]].<ref name="ERC">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]''</ref> While aboard the [[Starship/Legends|ship]] in the [[Dantus sector/Legends|Dantus sector]], Bren came across Pellaeon while the latter was touring the lower decks. Identifying Bren via the [[Cloning/Legends|clone's]] [[armor tally]], Pellaeon asked the [[Trooper/Legends|trooper]] if everyone found the mess deck accommodation satisfactory, to which Bren informed him of a [[Water/Legends|water]] pressure problem in A-seven-two [[Refresher/Legends|refreshers]] that had since been resolved. Pellaeon took note of the [[Officer/Legends|officer's]] statement on his [[Datapad/Legends|datapad]] before allowing Bren to carry on.<ref name="NoPrisoners" />

Like all clones of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]], Bren was created on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kamino/Legends|Kamino]] from the [[Clone template/Legends|genetic template]] of the [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Jango Fett/Legends|Jango Fett]] and as such was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] who stood at 1.83 [[Meter/Legends|meters]] tall<ref name="Clone Databank" /> and had [[Color/Legends|tan]] skin.<ref name="Skin" /> While serving aboard the ''Leveler'', Bren wore a [[Clone trooper armor/Legends|helmet]].<ref name="NoPrisoners" />

==Behind the scenes==
Bren appeared in the [[2009]] novel ''[[The Clone Wars: No Prisoners]]'', authored by [[Karen Traviss]].<ref name="NoPrisoners" />
